scope_as_frozen.original_full_context_marked: Quality control and preprocessing of FASTQ data could be considered resolved given the availability of several relevant tools. For instance, FASTQC (Andrews, 2010) is a Java-based quality control tool providing per-base and per-read quality profiling features. Cutadapt (Martin, 2011) is a commonly used adapter trimmer, which also provides some read-filtering features. Trimmomatic ([[TARGET_REFERENCE]]Bolger et al., 2014[[/TARGET_REFERENCE]]), another popular trimming adapter tool, can perform quality pruning using algorithms such as sliding window cutting. SOAPnuke (Chen et al., 2018) is a recently published tool for adapter trimming and read filtering with the implementation of MapReduce on Hadoop systems

original_explanation_reason: 证据支持Trimmomatic能够执行质量修剪（quality filtering），且Sliding Window（SW）是其质量修剪模式之一（D01:S04, D01:S08）。D01:S02提供了Sliding Window算法的具体机制（扫描5'端，当平均质量低于阈值时移除3'端），支持目标引用中关于“使用滑动窗口切割等算法进行质量修剪”的主张。证据未直接提及“popular”（流行）这一属性，也未直接证明其是“adapter tool”（尽管D01:S08提到adapter removal步骤，但目标引用主要强调其作为修剪工具执行质量修剪的能力，且D01:S04明确将其与质量模式关联）。
original_reason_assessment_proposed: 未直接证明其为adapter tool这一限制忽略了S08明确的adapter removal；不建议把原理由直接记为完全语义合格。其关于popular未直接获证的限定单独保留。
